w.t: and fell into a deep sleep.

f.t: Forms of the Hebrew *chesed* are translated here and in most cases throughout the Scriptures as *loving devotion*; the range of meaning includes *love*, *goodness*, *kindness*, *faithfulness*, and *mercy*, as well as *loyalty to a covenant*.
Or *was a great city to God*

f.t: Or *It was exceedingly evil to Jonah, and he became angry*
Hebrew *qiqayon*; that is, possibly the castor oil plant; also in verses 7, 9, and 10
